---
headline: The Luyten road has failed
from: luyten-crossing
---

Jumps on the road between Luyten Crossing and Brightwater are failing. The
road is unstable at both ends, and traders are turning for Marrow's far
gate instead.

The news breaks at Luyten Crossing and travels on ships, so each system
hears it on a different day (`world/information.md`). The engine works out
when from the jump graph.
